# app

```go
import "github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/internal/app"
```

Package app wires configuration, storage, the API server and background workers together.

Implementations plug in through the registries below, from init\(\) functions in their own files \(wire\_storage.go, wire\_tls.go\).

## type [Worker](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/app/app.go#L34>)
